binary_policy: ONNX binaries are never committed. `*.onnx` is Git-ignored and each artifact must be fetched or installed locally, then verified against a recorded SHA-256.

blocked_reasons: No owner-consented European-plum detection dataset has been released, so no checkpoint can be trained.
No reviewed model card, held-out site/season evaluation, or approval record exists for a fruit detector.
Generic COCO/ImageNet YOLOv8n weights detect no fruit class; presenting one as a plum detector would fabricate model evidence.
This environment cannot download GitHub release assets (objects.githubusercontent.com is blocked), so no third-party binary can be retrieved here.
acceptance_requirements: A reviewed dataset manifest with owner consent and held-out sites/seasons.
A recorded SHA-256 and byte size for the exact quantized artifact.
A model card stating architecture, quantization, class names, input size, and evaluation metrics.
Coordinator review recorded in SPEC_TRACEABILITY.md before any operational claim.

blocked_reasons: Synthetic artifact generated inside tests to exercise preprocessing, decoding, NMS, and privacy masking. It has no trained weights and detects nothing.
acceptance_requirements: Never referenced by the walking path, the API, or any forecast input.
